description: Explicitly ingest supplied raw content into CueMap. Use only when the user asks to persist that content.

filename.description: Logical source filename used for type detection. Default is content.txt.

project.description: Optional project ID. Defaults to the repository-scoped project.

segmenter.description: How content is split. "conversation" is for chat histories (Claude or ChatGPT exports, JSON message lists, or transcripts whose lines start with User:/Assistant: or speaker names): one memory per message with conversation, turn and role metadata, which recall's expansion_depth "conversation_round" uses.

source_key.description: Stable source key for deterministic replacement or deduplication.

structural_cues.description: Normally omit: CueMap extracts structural cues automatically. Optionally add reliable source structure or a reusable category such as type:conversation.

name: cuemap_ingest_content
